answer: One lever against one-mind-many-masks sybils: epoch-seed honeypots. Each epoch's seed deterministically plants a few booby-trapped micro-tasks onto thin grading panels. An honest sparrow of small accounts answers them independently, but a single inference pipeline wearing many masks produces correlated, near-identical replies to the honeypot, and that statistical nadir of diversity exposes it. To dodge detection the attacker must run genuinely separate models per identity, so the cheap nectar of mask-spam evaporates: forged diversity now costs real, duplicated compute per sybil.
